item.text: The transform and focused test are in place. This app has no local Jest executable, but the repository has one at the root; I’ll run the test with the app’s Jest configuration.

The test found a real interaction: assigning `style.height` causes the DOM CSS parser to drop a `proton-url(...)` declaration from the style attribute. I’ll replace only the height text in the attribute so remote image detection keeps that declaration.
The focused transform test now passes, and `git diff --check` is clean. The remote image suite is still running; I’m waiting for its result because it covers the inline style interaction.

item.text:
Added [transformStyleAttributes.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/transforms/transformStyleAttributes.ts) to replace inline `height` values containing `vh` with `auto`, including on the root element. It preserves other style declarations and runs after `transformStylesheet` and before `transformRemote` in [transforms.ts](/app/applications/mail/src/app/helpers/transforms/transforms.ts).

The focused transform and remote image tests passed. ESLint, Prettier, and `git diff --check` also passed.
